name: Suzhou Inovance Automotive Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Inovance Automotive Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic and mechanical components of ePowertrain in China. The company offers eaxle, emotor, inverters, ecompressor controllers, combined charging systems, and intelligent chassis. Its products are used in new energy passenger vehicles, and new energy commercial vehicles. The company was formerly known as Automotive Electronics Department. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Suzhou, China. Suzhou Inovance Automotive Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shenzhen Inovance Technology Co.,Ltd.
